status_note: Not tested by us. Everything here is copied from the vendor's pages on the dates given; run `python -m rak.models control minimax` before relying on it.

claude_code.why: min: the kit's hooks need onFailure: block (2.1.295+). pin: the version the kit was last developed against (2026-11-01); not tested with this endpoint by us.

limits.text: the Anthropic interface serves only MiniMax-M3.1-Flash and MiniMax-M3; the page does not mention Claude Code, so the model-role mapping here is ours
MiniMax-M3.1-Flash always thinks; sending thinking disabled returns 400. Effort none returns 400; an omitted effort defaults to max
temperature has no effect (always 1); top_p is fixed at 0.95; top_k, stop_sequences, mcp_servers, context_management and container are ignored
thinking tokens count toward max_tokens; a low value can stop with max_tokens and no text
Anthropic does not support routing Claude Code to non-Claude models; treat every Claude Code upgrade as untested until the positive control passes
